integrity: Proof states the valuation conventions, zero-indexed sets, recursive residues, boundary cases, and precise prior inputs. Verifier is standalone and its diagnostic scope is limited. Independent scientific audit has not been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Integer generalized bases b>=3 and unbordered factor lengths n>=2 only. The 2012 two-unbordered-factor classification and unborderedness lemma are cited prior results; new claims concern exact occurrence starts, densities and return gaps. Unindexed equivalent literature remains possible. Finite checker is not an infinite proof.
title: Affine occurrence laws and universal return gaps for unbordered factors of generalized period-doubling words
